purpose: Confirm on a fresh disjoint component batch the single detector that looked best on the exploratory n=64 batch, with the operating point, direction, event and success criterion all fixed in advance.

detector.definition: 1 - |topK(cached_parent field) intersect topK(sequence_only field)| / 8, with K = 8, both fields computed with zero mutant folds
detector.direction: higher means the cached-parent field is LESS trustworthy
detector.rule: flag the component when the two top-8 sets are completely disjoint

event.definition: the cached-parent rank of the exact best single mutant exceeds 8

exploratory_values_being_tested.selection_bias_warning: 0.72 was the maximum over roughly 15 signals and 5 events, about 675 evaluated rows, so it is optimistically biased and the confirmatory value is expected to be lower

success_criteria.primary: ROC AUC of the signal for the primary event is greater than 0.5 at one-sided alpha 0.05 on the fresh batch, by a DeLong or bootstrap interval
success_criteria.secondary: precision at threshold 1.0 exceeds the fresh batch's own base rate
success_criteria.interpretation_if_primary_fails: the detector is not confirmed and must not be used to set a budget; report it as an exploratory finding that did not replicate
success_criteria.interpretation_if_primary_passes_but_auc: report the confirmed AUC, not the exploratory 0.72; a detector near 0.6 has little deployment value at a 45 percent base rate

prohibited: changing the signal, direction, threshold, or event after seeing the fresh batch
reporting the best of several signals on the fresh batch as if it had been pre-specified
pooling the fresh batch with the exploratory 64 components for the confirmatory test
evaluating, scoring, inspecting or selecting on the repository test split
